asset_name.description: Snake_case slug for output directory and filenames, e.g. cute_robot

character_design_spec.description: Detailed physical description of shape, proportions, sturdy manifold limbs, flat-footed stance, and distinct front/back/side landmarks

turnaround_image_prompt.description: Complete prompt for generating a single square 1:1 (1024x1024) 2x2 orthographic turnaround sheet (Top-Left: FRONT, Top-Right: LEFT profile, Bottom-Left: BACK, Bottom-Right: RIGHT profile) on pure solid flat white #FFFFFF background without text labels, grid lines, or floor shadows

negative_constraints.description: Elements to avoid (text labels, grid lines, dividing borders, cast shadows, thin wires, floating parts, pedestals)
